name: Aleph-6
summary: Aleph-6, or ALEPH-6, also known as 4-phenylthio-2,5-dimethoxyamphetamine, is a psychedelic drug of the phenethylamine, amphetamine, and DOx families. It is one of the Aleph series of compounds.

sideEffects.en: Very little is known about it in people. Psychedelics of its family, the DOx amphetamines, tend to be long lasting and can cause anxiety, confusion, a raised heart rate and blood pressure, and difficult experiences.
sideEffects.zh: 它對人體的影響幾乎沒有資料。同家族的 DOx 類安非他命迷幻藥作用時間通常很長，可能引起焦慮、混亂、心跳與血壓上升，以及難受的經驗。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它对人体的影响几乎没有数据。同家族的 DOx 类安非他命迷幻药作用时间通常很长，可能引起焦虑、混乱、心跳与血压上升，以及难受的经验。

fact.en: Its sulphur atom is linked to a whole second benzene ring, which makes it one of the bulkiest members of Alexander Shulgin's Aleph series.
fact.zh: 它的硫原子上連著一整個苯環，使它成為 Alexander Shulgin 的 Aleph 系列中體積最大的成員之一。
fact.zhHans: 它的硫原子上连着一整个苯环，使它成为 Alexander Shulgin 的 Aleph 系列中体积最大的成员之一。
